# `ramp.falciparum`

## Falciparum Malaria Mathematical Epidemiology

------------------------------------------------------------------------

**INSTALL**

To install the latest version of `ramp.falciparum` from GitHub, run the
following lines of code in an R session. We also recommend loading the
supporting package `ramp.func`

    library(devtools)
    devtools::install_github("dd-harp/ramp.falciparum")
    devtools::install_github("dd-harp/ramp.func")

Then load them:

    library(ramp.falciparum)
    library(ramp.func)

## Falciparum Malaria

The health burden of falciparum malaria – a disease of humans caused by
infection with *Plasmodium falciparum* – is enormous, so there is a need
to understand malaria epidemiology well enough to manage it. The
epidemiology of falciparum malaria is complex. Exposure is highly
variable across locations, outcomes are related to age and cumulative
exposure, and malaria programs need to weigh tradeoffs between various
forms of malaria control. Mathematical models of malaria can serve an
indispensible role in all of this, but the models must be fit for
purpose, realistic enough to be compelling, accurate enough to useful,
and simple enough to be insightful.

## Mathematical Epidemiology

Ronald Ross developed the first mathematical model of malaria in 1908.

## Infection Dynamics

Dynamics of MoI, AoI, and the AoY

- [`zda()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/zda.md)
  : Compute infection density in a cohort of humans, \\z\_\bday(\alpha,
  a \|h)\\
- [`truePR()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/truePR.md)
  : Compute the true PR in a cohort as a function of age and exposure

### Multiplicity of Infection (MoI)

Methods to compute the MoI

- [`meanMoI()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/meanMoI.md)
  : The mean MoI in a host cohort of age \\a\\

- [`MoIDistPlot()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/MoIDistPlot.md)
  :

  Plot the output of
  [solveMMinfty](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/solveMMinfty.html)

### Age of Infection (AoI)

Methods to compute the AoI density and distribution functions, random
numbers, and moments

- [`dAoI()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/dAoI.md)
  : Compute the density function for AoI
- [`pAoI()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/pAoI.md)
  : Compute the distribution function for AoI
- [`rAoI()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/rAoI.md)
  : Random numbers for the AoI
- [`momentAoI()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/momentAoI.md)
  : Compute the moments for the AoI density function for a cohort of age
  a

### Age of the Youngest Infection (AoY)

Methods to compute the AoY density and distribution functions, random
numbers, and moments

- [`dAoY()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/dAoY.md)
  : The density function for the age of the youngest infection (AoY)
- [`pAoY()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/pAoY.md)
  : The distribution function for the age of the youngest infection
  (AoY)
- [`pAoY_long()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/pAoY_long.md)
  : Alternative method for computing the distribution function for the
  age of the youngest infection (AoY)
- [`rAoY()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/rAoY.md)
  : The random generation function for the age of the youngest infection
  (AoY)
- [`momentAoY()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/momentAoY.md)
  : Compute the moments for the AoY density function for a cohort of age
  a

### Youngest of N Infections (YoN)

Methods to compute the YoN density and distribution functions & random
numbers

- [`dYoN()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/dYoN.md)
  : The youngest of N infections, density function
- [`pYoN()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/pYoN.md)
  : The youngest of N infections, distribution function
- [`rYoN()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/rYoN.md)
  : The youngest of N infections, random numbers

### Hybrid Models

Methods to solve hybrid models

- [`dmda()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/dmda.md)
  : Compute the derivatives for MoI using a hybrid model
- [`solve_dm()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/solve_dm.md)
  : Solve the hybrid model for the MoI
- [`dpda()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/dpda.md)
  : Compute the derivatives for MoI and true PR
- [`solve_dpda()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/solve_dpda.md)
  : Solve a system of differential equations to compute the true PR and
  the MoI
- [`dAoIda()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/dAoIda.md)
  : Compute the derivatives of the AoI moments dynamically
- [`solve_dAoI()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/solve_dAoI.md)
  : Solve the system of differential equations to compute the moments of
  the AoI over time.
- [`dAoYda()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/dAoYda.md)
  : Compute the derivatives of the approximate moments of the AoY
  dynamically
- [`solve_dAoYda()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/solve_dAoYda.md)
  : Solve the system of differential equations to compute the
  approximate moments of the AoY over time.

## Parasite Densities

Expected densities by AoI

### F_mu(alpha)

A function to compute expected log10 parasites (mu) from the AoI (alpha)

- [`Fmu()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/Fmu.md)
  :

  Compute mean, expected parasite densities `mu` as a function of the
  age of infection `alpha`

- [`sFmu()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/sFmu.md)
  :

  Compute mean, expected parasite densities `mu` for multiple values of
  the age of infection `alpha`

- [`Fmu(`*`<W>`*`)`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/Fmu.W.md)
  :

  Compute expected log10 parasite densities, `mu`, as a function of the
  age of infection `alpha`

- [`par_Fmu_W()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/par_Fmu_W.md)
  :

  Set up parameters for
  [Fmu.W](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/Fmu.W.html)

- [`Fmu(`*`<base>`*`)`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/Fmu.base.md)
  :

  Compute expected log10 parasite densities, `mu`, as a function of the

  Set up parameters for

- [`Fmu(`*`<chronic>`*`)`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/Fmu.chronic.md)

### Omega defined

log10 parasites distributions from mu

- [`d_Omega()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/d_Omega.md)
  : The density function for parasite densities in a simple malaria
  infection
- [`p_Omega()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/p_Omega.md)
  : The density function for parasite densities as a function of the
  mean
- [`q_Omega()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/q_Omega.md)
  : The quantile function for parasite densities in a simple malaria
  infection
- [`r_Omega()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/r_Omega.md)
  : Random generation of parasite densities from a simple malaria
  infection

### Omega.beta

A modified beta distribution for log10 parasite distributions

- [`par_Omega_beta()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/par_Omega_beta.md)
  : The quantile function for parasite densities in a simple malaria
  infection

- [`d_Omega(`*`<beta>`*`)`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/d_Omega.beta.md)
  : Modified beta distribution, density function

- [`dbeta1()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/dbeta1.md)
  : Density function for the beta distribution, an alternative
  parameterization

- [`p_Omega(`*`<beta>`*`)`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/p_Omega.beta.md)
  : Modified beta distribution, distribution function

- [`pbeta1()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/pbeta1.md)
  : Disribution function for the beta distribution, an alternative
  parameterization

- [`q_Omega(`*`<beta>`*`)`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/q_Omega.beta.md)
  : Modified beta distribution, distribution function

- [`qbeta1()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/qbeta1.md)
  : The quantile function for the beta distribution, an alternative
  parameterization

- [`r_Omega(`*`<beta>`*`)`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/r_Omega.beta.md)
  : Modified beta distribution, random numbers

- [`rbeta1()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/rbeta1.md)
  : The random generation function for the beta distribution, an
  alternative parameterization Title

- [`sigma_mu()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/sigma_mu.md)
  : A function to compute the variance of the beta distrution as a
  function of the mean.

- [`sigma_mu(`*`<abc>`*`)`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/sigma_mu.abc.md)
  : A function that returns constrained values of the variance for the
  beta distrution as a function of the mean.

- [`par_sigma_abc()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/par_sigma_abc.md)
  :

  Parameters to configure
  [sigma_mu.abc](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/sigma_mu.abc.html)

  : Compute the moments of P_density

- [`rRda()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/rRda.md)
  : Random generation for M parasite densities in a host cohort with MoI

## Sampling

### Basic sampling functions

Parasite positivity and counts given log10 parasites

- [`d_detect()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/d_detect.md)
  : The probability of detecting parasites
- [`d_counts()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/d_counts.md)
  : The PDF for counting \\x\\ parasites
- [`p_counts()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/p_counts.md)
  : The CDF for counting \\x\\ parasites
- [`d_nz_counts_log()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/d_nz_counts_log.md)
  : The PDF for non-zero counts, \\\log\_{10}\\ transformed
- [`p_nz_counts_log()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/p_nz_counts_log.md)
  : The CDF for non-zero counts, \\\log\_{10}\\ transformed
- [`d_nz_counts_log_binned()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/d_nz_counts_log_binned.md)
  : The binned PDF for non-zero counts, \\\log\_{10}\\ transformed
- [`p_nz_counts_log_binned()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/p_nz_counts_log_binned.md)
  : The binned PDF for non-zero counts, \\\log\_{10}\\ transformed

### Poisson Sampling

- [`d_detect(`*`<nb>`*`)`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/d_detect.nb.md)

## MLE

Methods for maximum likelihood estimation

- [`llik_count()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/llik_count.md)
  : Compute the likelihood for a single parasite count datum
- [`llik_counts()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/llik_counts.md)
  : Compute the log likelihood for a set of parasites counts data
- [`counts_MLE()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/counts_MLE.md)
  : Compute the MLE for parasite counts data
- [`llik_counts_sz()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/llik_counts_sz.md)
  : Compute the log likelihood for a set of parasites counts data
- [`counts_MLE_sz()`](https://dd-harp.github.io/ramp.falciparum/reference/counts_MLE_sz.md)
  : Compute the MLE for parasite counts data
